chapter_name: Mindful Eating: A Path to a Healthy Body
learning_objective: 🎯 To learn about the special nutrients hidden in our food and how eating the right balance keeps our bodies strong, energetic, and fighting fit!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Just like a car needs petrol to run, our bodies need food to work and play. The special ingredients in food that give us energy and help us grow are called nutrients.
Different foods have different superpowers! Carbohydrates give instant energy, proteins build strong muscles, and vitamins and minerals act like shields to protect us from falling sick.
Eating only chocolates or only rice is not healthy. A balanced diet means eating a colourful mix of fruits, vegetables, grains, and proteins so your body gets everything it needs!

fun_activity.title: 🥗 Draw Your Super Plate
fun_activity.instructions: Take a blank paper and draw a plate. Fill it with colorful drawings of foods that make a perfectly balanced and healthy meal!

quick_recap: ⭐ Food provides the energy and building blocks our bodies need to survive and grow.
⭐ Carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, and minerals are the main nutrients.
⭐ A balanced diet prevents diseases and keeps us active all day long.
